notes: S2-FIX3 F73 (decision 2026-11-16 #1; §5.3, §9.1 rule 3): the only declaration of a human key (not in the keyset) has no sigs member (E_SIG_REQUIRED, check (3)); a device declaration names that key as its owner and carries the owner's cosignature. A declaration that fails the §14.1 structural group (sigs presence included) never takes part in class determination, so the owner cannot be resolved: the device declaration is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN, not E_KEY_UNTRUSTED (an owner that resolves but is not trusted). The owner's cosignature still verifies against the material its record states (sigs state valid).
